name: happy-path
description: 一个目标产物、两条线索（auth-flow / protocol）、六条陈述（四条有可复现步骤，两条是明确标注的推断）：P0 枚举出 2×7=14 个候选（每条线索：产物身份行 1 个 + 每条陈述的原文行与可复现性行各 1 个），P1 全部准入，P2 按「一条线索」分成 2 捆 —— 每捆 7 个候选，这正是「一捆 = 一条线索」而不是「一捆 = 一个候选」的证据，也意味着一条推断与支持/推翻它的观察必然同捆。锚点样例覆盖 正例（declared-locator、recomputed-unique、推断保留猜想标注 inference-labelled、搬迁确认、链级确认）、反例（转述不锚定、样本哈希不符、把不可复现的推断写成已验证、未知产物、行号与原文矛盾、kind 不符、没有登记表）与歧义（同一行命中两份笔记）。

observations.statement: The firmware exposes a UART shell on pin 12 without authentication.

steps: wire pin 12 to a 3.3V UART adapter at 115200 8N1
power the board with the debug header shorted
observe the `#` prompt without any credential

observations.statement: The shell accepts the command `dumpcfg` on the debug port.

steps: run `dumpcfg` and observe the configuration dump

observations.statement: The configuration blob is probably AES-128-CBC with a fixed IV.
The device speaks a length-prefixed binary protocol on TCP 9000.

steps: open a TCP session to port 9000

observations.statement: The session token is a monotonic counter and can be replayed across sessions.
The string `X-Auth-Debug` appears in the release binary.

noteFragments: 候选集不可先验枚举、成本无上界

positive.note: 逐字抄写陈述行 + 正确行号 + 样本哈希一致 -> declared-locator：引擎确认了声明的行、样本与复现状态。
